verdict.rationale: ELSTER is an online tax-filing service, and user-defined automation rules are a conceivable capability for such a platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no rule engine, triggers or event-driven actions. MeinELSTER+'s automatic tax-return creation is a fixed built-in feature, not a user-defined rule, and third-party ELSTER-compatible software is an external tool, so neither counts.
